Port Antonio Jamaica by rental car: how to get there, what to do nearby and how to book.

Port Antonio. Beaches and waterfalls. 🌴

Portland is green, wild and worth the drive.

Green hills, calm bays and waterfalls. Portland is where Jamaica slows down.

Getting there: Pick up at Norman Manley or our Kingston offices. Allow about 2 to 2.5 hours going east.

Boston Bay for jerk, Reach Falls and Winnifred Beach are all in Portland.
